cards.definition: Free to meet or to be used at a certain time.
cards.example:
- Are you available on Thursday afternoon for a quick call?
Você está disponível quinta à tarde para uma reunião rápida?
- The big room is not available before noon.
A sala grande não está disponível antes do meio-dia.
- She was available all morning, but nobody called her.
Ela ficou disponível a manhã toda, mas ninguém ligou para ela.
cards.note: Availability = disponibilidade: What is your availability? Serve para pessoas, salas e produtos. O contrário é unavailable, e a preposição de tempo é on ou at.

cards.definition: To arrange a place or a time in advance.
cards.example:
- I booked the meeting room for two o'clock.
Reservei a sala de reunião para as duas horas.
- Can you book a taxi for seven in the morning?
Você pode reservar um táxi para as sete da manhã?
- The hotel was fully booked, so we changed the dates.
O hotel estava lotado, então mudamos as datas.
cards.note: Verbo! Fully booked = lotado, sem horários. Passado: booked. Para outra pessoa: book someone a room ou book a room for someone.

cards.definition: To change an appointment to a different day or time.
cards.example:
- Can we reschedule our meeting to Friday morning?
Podemos remarcar nossa reunião para sexta de manhã?
- They rescheduled the interview twice in one week.
Eles remarcaram a entrevista duas vezes em uma semana.
- I had to reschedule because my flight was canceled.
Tive que remarcar porque meu voo foi cancelado.
cards.note: Reschedule TO + novo dia ou horário. Passado: rescheduled. Remarcar muda a data para qualquer lado; postpone só empurra para depois.

cards.definition: To move an event to a later date.
cards.example:
- They postponed the launch to the next quarter.
Eles adiaram o lançamento para o próximo trimestre.
- The client asked us to postpone the visit by two weeks.
O cliente pediu para adiarmos a visita em duas semanas.
- We postponed the decision until the numbers arrived.
Adiamos a decisão até os números chegarem.
cards.note: Adiar é empurrar para depois; antecipar é move up ou bring forward. Passado: postponed. Em conversa informal, o sinônimo natural é put off.

cards.definition: A short period of time in a schedule for one activity.
cards.example:
- I have a free slot between ten and eleven.
Tenho uma janela livre entre dez e onze.
- Can you take the nine o'clock slot tomorrow?
Você consegue pegar o horário das nove amanhã?
- They gave us a thirty-minute slot at the end of the day.
Eles nos deram uma janela de trinta minutos no fim do dia.
cards.note: Time slot; a 30-minute slot. Colocações comuns: a free slot, book a slot, the last slot. Não é vaga de emprego, que é a position ou an opening.

cards.definition: To be later than the time you planned.
cards.example:
- Sorry, I am running late — start without me.
Desculpe, estou me atrasando — comecem sem mim.
- The first call ran late, so we lost ten minutes.
A primeira call atrasou, então perdemos dez minutos.
- I never want to run late for an interview.
Nunca quero chegar atrasado em uma entrevista.
cards.note: I am running late = estou me atrasando, ainda a caminho. Passado: ran late. Vale para pessoas e para reuniões: the meeting is running late.

cards.definition: To put something in the calendar without confirming it yet.
cards.example:
- Let's pencil in Tuesday at nine and confirm by email tomorrow.
Vamos marcar terça às nove a lápis e confirmar por e-mail amanhã.
- I pencilled you in for Monday at four.
Marquei você provisoriamente para segunda às quatro.
- Can you pencil in a call before the trip?
Você pode marcar uma call provisória antes da viagem?
cards.note: Vem de escrever a lápis: dá para apagar. É separável: pencil you in for Monday. Passado: pencilled in, ou penciled in na grafia americana.

cards.translation: marcar dois compromissos no mesmo horário
cards.definition: To promise the same time to two different appointments.
cards.example:
- I double-booked myself: two calls at three o'clock.
Marquei duas coisas no mesmo horário: duas calls às três.
- The hotel double-booked our room for that weekend.
O hotel reservou nosso quarto em duplicidade naquele fim de semana.
- Check the calendar so you do not double-book the room.
Confira o calendário para não reservar a sala em duplicidade.
cards.note: Double-book yourself — o pesadelo clássico da agenda. Sempre com hífen; o passado é double-booked. Vale para pessoas, salas e hotéis.

cards.definition: To believe something is true without checking it.
cards.example:
- I assume the meeting is still on for Monday, right?
Suponho que a reunião ainda está de pé na segunda, certo?
- We assumed everyone had read the agenda, and we were wrong.
Presumimos que todos tinham lido a pauta, e estávamos errados.
- Do not assume the client is free just because the calendar is empty.
Não presuma que o cliente está livre só porque a agenda está vazia.
cards.note: “Assumir um cargo” é take over; “assumir um erro” é admit. Passado: assumed. Muito usado com that: I assume that the room is free.

cards.definition: Facts and numbers that you collect and study.
cards.example:
- The report has sales data from January to June.
O relatório tem dados de vendas de janeiro a junho.
- We need more data before we change the price.
Precisamos de mais dados antes de mudar o preço.
- The data shows that Mondays are our busiest day.
Os dados mostram que a segunda é o nosso dia mais cheio.
cards.note: “Data” do calendário é date: What is the date today? No inglês do dia a dia, data leva verbo no singular: the data shows. Não existe a forma “datas”.

questions.prompt: The launch will now happen three months later. What did the company do?
questions.explanation: “Postpone” means to move an event to a later date.

questions.prompt: I am not _____ before eleven, but my afternoon is completely free.
questions.explanation: “Available” means free to meet at that time.

questions.prompt: Precisamos remarcar a entrevista para a semana que vem.
questions.answer: We need to reschedule the interview to next week.|We need to reschedule the interview for next week.
questions.explanation: “Reschedule” means to move an appointment to another day or time.

questions.prompt: You accepted two different calls at three o'clock. What happened?
questions.explanation: To “double-book” is to give the same time to two appointments.

questions.prompt: Could you _____ a table for six people near the office?
questions.explanation: “Book” means to arrange a place or a time in advance.

questions.prompt: Eu não quero me atrasar de novo.
questions.answer: I don't want to run late again.|I do not want to run late again.
questions.explanation: “Run late” means to be later than you planned.

questions.prompt: Your manager did not answer, but you believe the meeting is still on. What do you say?
options: I admit the meeting is still on.
I take over the meeting is still on.
I assume the meeting is still on.
I assist the meeting is still on.
questions.answer: I assume the meeting is still on.
questions.explanation: “Assume” means to believe something without confirming it.

questions.prompt: The doctor gave me the last _____ on Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: A “slot” is a short period of time reserved in a schedule.

questions.prompt: Vamos marcar sexta à tarde a lápis por enquanto.
questions.answer: Let's pencil in Friday afternoon for now.|Shall we pencil in Friday afternoon for now?
questions.explanation: “Pencil in” means to note a time that is not confirmed yet.

questions.prompt: Which sentence talks about numbers and information, not about the calendar?
options: Please confirm the data of the meeting.
The data of the call is May 12th.
The team collected data from two hundred users.
questions.answer: The team collected data from two hundred users.
questions.explanation: “Data” is information; the day on the calendar is the “date”.
